test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: If 19 February 2004 was a Thursday, then what was the day of the week on 2 March 2019?
solution: Given: **19 February 2004** was Thursday. Now, 2004 to 2019 = 15 Years (11 Ordinary Years and 4 Leap Years). And, In 15 Years = 4 Leap years and 11 Ordinary Years. So, 4 Leap Years have 8 odd days, And, 11 Ordinary Years have 11 odd days. Total odd days = 8 + 11 = 19.
